title: Jackson and Bernstein Inequalities with Explicit Weight Dependence for Band-Limited Wavelet Approximation in Weighted Besov Spaces
summary: We prove direct and inverse estimates for band-limited biorthogonal wavelet systems in weighted Besov spaces with Muckenhoupt weights. On functions recovered from their wavelet expansion along the dyadic tree of the unit cube, the error of approximation by a prescribed number of terms decays at a rate set by the smoothness-to-dimension ratio, and this exponent cannot be increased.
